motivation: The frozen G1 field statistic is sensitive to within-species spatial transition architecture even when species-specific boundaries are independent. This new method asks a different question: whether a boundary direction learned from one species set predicts transition structure in disjoint species beyond an independent-boundary baseline.
role: Prospective synthetic method development only. It cannot rescue or reclassify G1, Stage 6, environmental mean effects, heterogeneity tests, or any other observed result.

input_geometry.species_split: same fixed 184 training / 185 evaluation species split used in prior response-transfer work
input_geometry.photo_sampling: deterministic random priority within species from retained classifiable rows; no replacement

target_estimand: Cross-species geographic boundary sharing: predictive evidence that a common spherical boundary orientation inferred from training species generalizes to disjoint evaluation species, conditional on allowing every species to have its own strong spatial boundary under the null.

synthetic_generator.species_specific_boundary: continuous random unit normal in R3 independently for each non-sharing species
synthetic_generator.shared_boundary: one continuous random unit normal in R3 assigned to the prespecified shared fraction of species
synthetic_generator.species_response_sign: random +/-1 independently by species and marginalized by the fitted model
synthetic_generator.species_threshold: offset in signed dot-product units; either zero, shared common offset, or independent N(0, threshold_sd)
synthetic_generator.important_null_property: shared_fraction=0 with amplitude>0 is a structured independent-boundary null, not an alternative

predictive_model.axis_grid: 96 fixed antipodally unique unit normals in R3 generated once from seed 202609070801; reused for all stages/replicates
predictive_model.training: form posterior over sharing fraction and common boundary axis from training-species likelihoods only
predictive_model.evaluation: held-out evaluation-species predictive log-density gain relative to an independent-axis prior; evaluation labels never update training posterior
predictive_model.score: equal evaluation-species mean predictive log-density gain per photo, averaged over 100 evaluation species

replication.deterministic_sharding: calibration and evaluation each split into ten nonoverlapping 25-replicate shards
same synthetic world within a replicate is scored once; no favourable reruns

calibration.threshold: maximum empirical 97.5th percentile (method=higher) across all nine structured-null calibration arms

required_outputs: nine structured-null calibration quantiles and one global threshold
all nuisance and positive decision rates with Wilson 95% intervals
power as a function of shared fraction and amplitude
independent recomputation of threshold and every decision count
claim_ceiling: Synthetic qualification of a sharedness-specific species-disjoint geographic predictive statistic on actual photo geometry. Not evidence that real flower-colour boundaries are shared and not a rescue of any frozen observed-data result.
